points: \item Implemented a self-correcting RAG system using LangChain and Mistral 7B, improving answer reliability and supporting complex decision-support applications.
\item Built a hybrid retrieval workflow combining dense embeddings and BM25 search, enhancing relevance and coverage of retrieved documents for multivariate data analysis.
\item Developed an LLM-as-Judge evaluation pipeline to assess faithfulness and relevance across hundreds of QA examples, ensuring reliable model output.
\item Introduced batched query extraction using Python and SQL, reducing processing overhead by ~80% per query and enabling efficient handling of large data sets.
\item Designed an ML-based anomaly detection system for workflows, reducing redundant prompts by 25%, directly aligning with pattern of life and anomaly detection requirements.
\item Containerized and deployed scalable AI solutions using Docker and AWS, ensuring robust pipelines for research prototypes.
meta_company: The Applied Research Laboratory at Penn State University
